Title: Force of Will and Form of mist (hey Scalpel and LSJ!)

Messages.Author: Karl Innes
Messages.Body:
Someone recently brought this to my attention...

The card form of mist stipulates that after the bleed action or
the combat is complete, the vampire takes the aggravated damage.(one or
two points) My question is this: If during the ensuing combat the
vampire plays Form of Mist at the superior level, what happens???

1/ Does the vampire take the aggro damage after the combat is
complete and go to torpor/burn without completing the bleed action??

2/or does the vampire continue the bleed action and then take
the aggro damage after the bleed action is completed??

Thanks, Karl
